## Summary

Extracted the inlined additional-email logic from `src/routes/profile/+page.svelte` into a co-located pure util and added real unit tests. Behavior is unchanged — the page remains the source of truth.

### New helper API — `src/lib/utils/profileEmails.ts`
- `EMAIL_SLOT_COLUMNS` — readonly tuple `['email_1' … 'email_5']`; `EmailSlotColumn` type derived from it.
- `isValidEmail(email: string): boolean` — trims then tests the exact page regex `/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/`.
- `isDuplicateEmail(candidate: string, existing: string[]): boolean` — candidate trimmed + lower-cased, compared case-insensitively against `existing` (caller passes the primary email plus the relevant additional emails).
- `firstAvailableSlot(slots: (string|null)[]): number | null` — first empty slot via `!slot` (null or empty string), `null` when full; replaces the old `findIndex(... ) === -1` sentinel.
- `slotIndexOfEmail(slots, email): number | null` — exact-match column lookup for edit/delete; `null` when absent.
- `slotColumn(index): EmailSlotColumn | null` — maps a slot index to its `email_N` column name.

### How the page consumes it
- `saveNewEmail`: `isValidEmail` → `isDuplicateEmail([userEmail, ...additionalEmails])` → `firstAvailableSlot` + `slotColumn`.
- `saveEditedEmail`: `isValidEmail` → `isDuplicateEmail` against `[userEmail, ...additionalEmails without the edited index]` → `slotIndexOfEmail` + `slotColumn`.
- `deleteEmail`: `slotIndexOfEmail` + `slotColumn`, then sets that column to NULL (no shifting). The now-`| null` return is guarded (`columnToUpdate === null`) so it's safe as a computed key. Fixed a pre-existing unused-`index` lint error while in the file.

### Tests
- `src/lib/utils/profileEmails.spec.ts` — 32 tests: valid/invalid formats (trim, missing @/dot/local-part, internal spaces, double @), duplicate case-insensitivity on both sides incl. matching the primary, first-available-slot across empty/partial/full and empty-string-as-empty, exact-match column lookup, index→column mapping, and add-then-delete-no-shift behavior.
- Updated one assertion in the existing source-string test `src/lib/tests/profile-page.spec.ts` to also accept `isValidEmail` (the extraction moved the `emailRegex`/`test(` string it grepped for). All other grep assertions still hold (`email_1`/`email_5`, `columnToUpdate`, `.update(... null)` remain in the page).

### Verification
- `npm run test:unit` on both files: **65 passed** (32 new + 33 existing source-string).
- `npm run check`: **0 errors, 0 warnings**.
- ESLint clean on the three TS files. One pre-existing `no-navigation-without-resolve` error remains on the page's `href="/login"` — it's pervasive across committed code (8 identical instances in `+layout.svelte`) and unrelated to this change, so left as-is.

No commits made.</result>

### How the seam is wired
- Added a top-level `vi.mock('./ExpenseService', ...)` backed by a `vi.hoisted` object of two typed spies (`getVendorRule`, `assignCategory`) — no `any`. `new ExpenseService(supabase)` inside the impl returns those spies.

2. Happy path: `assignCategory('receipt-new-1', 'cat-shopping', 'auto')`.

- "Email receipt flow" (Req 6): that flow lives in `supabase/functions/resend/index.ts`, not reachable through `ReceiptService`. Repurposed into a real guard test (no merchant → no lookup) plus an added family-scoping guard test (no `family_id` → no assign), with an explanatory comment.
- "Concurrency/race conditions": impl has no concurrency logic; rewritten as sequential repeat-upload behavior.

- `npm run check` (svelte-check) → **0 errors, 0 warnings**.
- `npx eslint` on the file → clean; formatted with `npx prettier --write` on the single touched file only. No commits made.</result>

# YFL Expense Tracker

Family expense tracking app built with SvelteKit 2, Svelte 5, Supabase, and Tailwind CSS 4.

## Commands

```bash
npm run dev          # Dev server on localhost:5173
npm run build        # Production build
npm run check        # Type checking (svelte-check)
npm run test:unit    # Vitest unit tests
npm run test:e2e     # Playwright e2e tests
npm test             # Full test suite (unit + e2e)
npm run lint         # Prettier check + ESLint
npm run format       # Auto-format with Prettier
npm run spec:validate # Validate spec traceability
```

## Architecture

- **Routes:** `src/routes/` — SvelteKit file-based routing
- **Services:** `src/lib/services/` — Business logic (ExpenseService, ReceiptService, etc.). Some use DI (take Supabase client as param), others use singleton pattern with module-level import.
- **Models:** `src/lib/models/` — TypeScript data models
- **Components:** `src/lib/components/` — Reusable Svelte components
- **Utils:** `src/lib/utils/` — Helper functions with co-located `.spec.ts` tests
- **Server:** `src/lib/server/` — Server-only code (file validation, OCR processing)
- **CSV Parsers:** `src/lib/services/csvParsers/` — Bank-specific CSV parsers (Amex, PC Financial, RBC, TD, Simplii, EQ Bank, Wealth Simple) with `BaseCSVParser` and `CSVParserFactory` for auto-detection
- **Docs:** `docs/` — Project documentation. `docs/adr/` (architecture decision records), `docs/plans/` (design docs), `docs/prd-*.md` (PRDs — status tracked via front-matter, not folder), `docs/product-backlog.md` (the single working list — features, bugs, engineering, and open refactoring items as one-liners) plus `docs/refactoring-backlog.md` (detailed RF-NN reference, not a separate to-do list), `docs/domain-model.md` (ubiquitous-language glossary). Prefer `docs/` over root for any new note or plan; the root keeps only `README.md` and `CLAUDE.md`.
- **Migrations:** `supabase/migrations/` — SQL migrations (schema + RLS policies)

## Supabase Migrations

Migrations live in `supabase/migrations/` as numbered SQL files. The project is linked to the remote Supabase project (`YFL Expense Tracker`, region `ca-central-1`).

```bash
supabase migration list           # Show local vs remote migration status
supabase db push                  # Push pending migrations to remote database
supabase db push --dry-run        # Preview what would be applied without running
supabase migration new <name>     # Create a new empty migration file
supabase db diff --schema public  # Generate migration from local schema changes
supabase db reset                 # Reset local DB and re-run all migrations (destructive)
```

**Naming convention:** `YYYYMMDD_description.sql` (e.g. `20260225_secure_receipts_storage.sql`). Some older migrations use sequential numbering (`001_init.sql`).

**Important:** The migration role does NOT own `storage.objects`, so `COMMENT ON POLICY` and `ALTER TABLE` on storage tables will fail. Stick to `CREATE POLICY` / `DROP POLICY` / `UPDATE storage.buckets` for storage changes.

## Key Patterns

- **Expenses are computed, not stored.** No "expenses" table — expenses are joins of receipts + expense_categories + categories. Each receipt maps to exactly one expense (1:1).
- **All data is family-scoped.** Users belong to families via `family_members`. RLS policies enforce family-level access on receipts, transactions, categories, and vendor rules.
- **Receipt storage is private.** The `receipts` bucket is private — all file access uses signed URLs via `getSignedReceiptUrl()` from `src/lib/utils/signedUrl.ts`. Pages cache signed URLs in a reactive `signedUrls` map loaded via `$effect`. OCR uses short-lived signed URLs (5 min expiry). Display uses 1-hour expiry.
- **Storage RLS is family-scoped for reads.** Family members can read each other's receipt files. Write/delete is restricted to the file owner (path prefix = `user_id`).
- **Auto-categorization:** Vendor rules map normalized merchant names to categories. Applied on page load for uncategorized expenses. Normalization: lowercase, strip special chars, trim.
- **Date pickers use flowbite-svelte.** Always use `<Datepicker>` from `flowbite-svelte` with `toDate()` and `toISODateString()` helpers from `$lib/utils/dateConversion`. Never use raw `<input type="date">`.
- **Never use `new Date("YYYY-MM-DD")` for date-only strings.** JavaScript parses bare date strings as UTC midnight, which shifts to the previous day in timezones west of UTC. Always use `toDate()` to parse or `formatDate()` to display — both from `$lib/utils/dateConversion`. These parse year/month/day parts manually to construct local-time Date objects.
- **Date filters preserved in URL** via `preserveFilters()` helper in `+layout.svelte`.
- **Version tracking** in `src/lib/version.ts`. Increment by 0.01 for small changes, 0.1 for features.
- **Transaction amounts: negative = expense, positive = refund/credit.** This matches the UI display (red = negative = expense, green = positive = credit). Most banks (PC Financial, EQ Bank, RBC, TD, Simplii) already use negative for expenses so parsers keep signs as-is (`invertSign: false`). Only American Express uses positive for expenses and needs `invertSign: true`. Wealth Simple CSV exports have inconsistent signs across downloads, so the parser uses the `type` column (Purchase → negative, Payment/Refund → positive) instead of `invertSign`. See `BaseCSVParser.normalizeAmount()`.
- **XLS/XLSX import supported.** Excel files are converted to CSV via `ExcelToCSVConverter` (SheetJS) before passing through the same parser pipeline. File type detected by extension/MIME.

## Gotchas

- Dual test environments: browser tests use Playwright provider, server tests use Node.js — configured in `vite.config.ts` under `test.projects`
- PDFs go directly to Mistral Vision API (pixtral-12b) — no conversion needed
- Suspicious date flag triggers for receipts >42 days old or future-dated
- Multi-email support: primary email in `auth.users`, up to 5 additional in `profiles` table. Email receipt ingestion checks both.
- File uploads: JPEG/PNG/HEIC up to 5MB, PDF up to 10MB. Validated client-side and server-side (`src/lib/server/fileValidation.ts`)
- Recent migrations (Jan–Feb 2026) refactored family-scoping, fixed RLS recursion issues, and secured storage — be careful modifying RLS policies
- Receipt image URLs are async (signed URLs). Components use `$effect` + `Promise.then()` to load them, not synchronous calls. Never use `getPublicUrl()`.
- Transaction imports accept CSV, XLS, and XLSX files. Excel files are read as ArrayBuffer and converted to CSV text before parsing.
- The `transactions` table uses `excluded` (boolean) for soft-delete. The UI shows "Exclude/Include" buttons. The database column was originally named `ignored` in older code paths.
- Debugging Resend (email receipts): start at <https://resend.com/webhooks> — it shows the endpoint **Signing Secret** (`whsec_…`, must equal Supabase's `RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET`) and the delivery log with the status our `resend` function returned. The webhook fails closed: `401` = signature mismatch, `500` = secret not configured. See `docs/email-notifications.md`.
- Image resize before upload: client-side, native Canvas (zero deps), 2000px longest axis, 85% quality, JPEG/PNG only (skips PDF + HEIC), falls back to the original file on any failure. Wired in `ReceiptService.uploadAndCreate()`; logic in `src/lib/utils/imageResize.ts`.
- `overflow-x-auto` clips dropdowns in BOTH axes: a wrapper whose `overflow-x` is non-visible has its computed `overflow-y` become `auto` (not `visible`), so `overflow-x-auto` on a table wrapper clips absolutely-positioned dropdown menus vertically too. Keep the expenses table wrapper free of it; position menus with `right-0`.
- Date-parsing correction vs flag windows: OCR date correction uses a 90-day window (`PLAUSIBILITY_WINDOW_DAYS`) while the suspicious-date FLAG uses 42 days — a 43–90-day date can be auto-accepted by the parser yet still flagged. Two failure modes: format-ambiguity (auto-fixable) vs wrong-token extraction (only flaggable). Fixing `a11y_label_has_associated_control` in this SvelteKit app — apply by case:

- **Native input/select/textarea** → explicit `for`/`id` (static descriptive ids,
  forms render once per page so no `$props.id()` needed).
- **flowbite `<Datepicker>` and custom components (e.g. `CategoryDropdown`)** → **wrap**
  the control inside the `<label>`. `for`/`id` can't reach the control because
  flowbite's `Datepicker` does NOT forward `id`/rest props to its inner `<input>`.
  svelte-check accepts a `<label>` wrapping a component.
- **Display-only captions** that label no editable control (profile Primary Email /
  User ID / Account Created; ReceiptEditModal "Receipt Image") → convert `<label>` to
  `<span>`. They were false-positive labels.

`state_referenced_locally` for an intentional "seed local `$state` from a prop/derived
once" pattern: wrap the read in `untrack(() => ...)` (import from `svelte`), or seed
from the underlying source (e.g. URL params) instead of the `$derived`.

**`$state` typing gotcha:** `let x: T | null = $state(null)` can make svelte-check
resolve the annotated type to `never` (property access then errors as "does not exist
on type 'never'"). Use the idiomatic `let x = $state<T | null>(null)` instead. Seen in
profile/reconciliation. Also: flowbite `<Datepicker>` `onselect` passes a `DateOrRange`
(`Date | { from?; to? }`) — narrow it with `dateOrRangeToDate()` from
`$lib/utils/dateConversion` before `toISODateString()`. Async `onMount` callbacks can't
return a cleanup; subscribe synchronously + run async load in a `void (async () => …)()`
IIFE + return a sync teardown.

**Prettier gotcha:** this repo's Prettier enforces Svelte attribute **shorthand**
(`categories={categories}` → `{categories}`; no `svelteAllowShorthand:false`). Running
`npm run format` can rewrite props and **break source-regex unit tests** that assert
`/prop\s*=\s*\{/`. Fix the test regex to accept both forms, not the formatting. Note
the committed tree is already Prettier- and ESLint-dirty in places, and `npm run check`
has ~146 pre-existing TS errors — see `.scratch/check-cleanup/` for the cleanup plan.

Mark's rule for GUIs: **all the real testing is at the unit level; Playwright/e2e
exists only to prove the UI is attached to the well-tested pieces** — a thin seam
check, not a place to re-test business logic or boundaries.

**Why:** Stated directly during RF-02. It sets the altitude for every UI test
decision: don't push logic coverage into slow, flaky browser tests.

**How to apply:**
- Put correctness (filtering, validation, date math, param building) in pure
  node-unit tests (see [[feedback_validate_characterization_tests_with_oracle]]).
- For each UI feature, add at most ONE thin Playwright flow proving the wiring:
  control → state → action → URL/DOM result (and reset). No boundary/edge matrices
  in Playwright — those live in unit tests.
- Treat "unit logic wearing a Playwright costume" as a smell. This repo's
  `e2e/date-filter-url-preservation.spec.ts` never opens a browser (pure
  URLSearchParams asserts) — that is fake e2e and should be replaced by a real
  seam test, not kept.
- Harness reality (as of RF-02): there is NO working authenticated browser e2e —
  no globalSetup/storageState/auth fixture/seeding; the only real e2e is
  `demo.test.ts` (unauth home h1); the `tests/*.spec.ts` Playwright files are
  orphaned (outside `testDir: 'e2e'`, no auth) and never run. Adding a real seam
  test needs an auth+data harness first; prefer `page.route()` mocking of the
  Supabase REST/auth calls (we don't test the backend) over a live test project.

---
name: project_weak_unit_tests_source_introspection
description: Many .spec.ts files in this repo are source-introspection or inline-reimplementation, not behavioral tests — don't over-trust green checks
metadata:
  type: project
---

Discovered during the 2026-07-08 full spec-audit (40 `specs/specifications/*.md`
files, 6 parallel agents, before deleting `specs/`): a large share of this repo's
`.spec.ts`/`.test.ts` files that *look* like unit tests are one of two weaker
patterns instead of real behavioral tests:

1. **Source-introspection** — `readFileSync('+page.svelte')` + `toContain`/`toMatch`
   against the raw source text (e.g. asserting a string like `uploading = true`
   appears somewhere in the file). These prove a string is present, not that the
   behavior works. They also make refactors look like regressions even when
   behavior is preserved — see [[project_a11y_label_and_prettier_shorthand]] for
   the Prettier-shorthand case, and this session's `receipts-page.spec.ts` upr2a
   block, which broke on the `batchUpload.ts` extraction and had to be rewritten
   to assert the delegation instead of the old inline loop.
2. **Inline re-implementation** — the test hand-rewrites the logic under test
   inline (e.g. `let zoom = 100; zoom += 50; expect(zoom).toBe(150)`) rather than
   importing and exercising the real function/component state. Notable example:
   `src/lib/components/ReceiptImageViewer.spec.ts` (~120 tests) re-implements the
   zoom/pan arithmetic inline instead of driving the component — near-zero
   regression protection despite the large test count.

**Why this matters:** a high test count or a green run in these files is not
evidence the underlying behavior is correct or would catch a regression. Page-level
`*-page.spec.ts` files under `src/lib/tests/` are frequently source-introspection;
component specs can be either pattern.

**How to apply:**
- Before trusting "it's covered" for a page/component behavior, open the test and
  check whether it imports/exercises real code vs. grepping source text or
  re-deriving the arithmetic locally.
- When extracting logic out of a `.svelte` file into a util (as with
  `batchUpload.ts`, `profileEmails.ts`), expect co-located source-introspection
  tests to break on the extraction even though behavior is unchanged — that's a
  known false-positive category, not a sign the refactor broke something. Rewrite
  those assertions to check delegation/wiring, not the old inline pattern.
- Not treated as a fillable "missing unit test" gap by itself — the fix is a test
  refactor (import real code) or component-state extraction, not new coverage.
  `ReceiptImageViewer.spec.ts` was flagged but left as-is; only worth revisiting if
  that component is refactored to extract a pure state module.
- Relates to [[feedback_testing_pyramid_playwright_seam_only]] (Playwright is
  deliberately thin) — this is the mirror problem at the *unit* level: tests that
  look thorough but aren't actually behavioral.

# Clear the remaining `npm run check` errors (services + test files)

Status: needs-triage
Type: bug

## Parent

`.scratch/check-cleanup/PRD.md`

## What to build

After issues 03 & 04, `npm run check` still reports ~118 errors that were never
ticketed. Drive them to 0 so the check is fully green. They split into two groups —
re-measure with `npm run check` before starting, counts drift.

**Non-test source (~12) — fix these first, they affect shipping code:**

- `OcrService.ts` (×2) — `ChatCompletionResponse | undefined` not assignable / possibly
  undefined.
- `PDFExportService.ts` — `Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike>` not assignable to `BlobPart`.
- `ReconciliationService.ts` — imports `DuplicateReceiptInfo` from
  `$lib/models/Reconciliation`, which doesn't export it.
- 6 csvParsers (Amex, EQBank, PCFinancial, RBCFinancial, Simplii, TDBank) — same shape:
  `number | null` not assignable to `number`.
- `expenses/+page.svelte` (×2) — `CategoryService`'s `Category[]` vs `$lib/types/Category`'s
  `Category[]` are two different `Category` types; reconcile to one.
- `transactions/+page.svelte` — `editRow` is possibly `null` at a use site.

**Test files (~106):** concentrated in `family-category-visibility.spec.ts` (~31),
`ReceiptService.spec.ts` (~20), `CSVExportService.spec.ts` (~15),
`expenses-page-filters.spec.ts` (~10), `ReconciliationService.spec.ts` (~9), and others.
Many are likely the same few root causes (shared mock/type drift) repeated — triage by
root cause, not one-by-one.

Note: the `let x: T | null = $state(null)` → `never` gotcha that issue 04 hit may recur
here; the fix is `let x = $state<T | null>(null)`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `npm run check` reports **0 ERRORS** (and stays at 0 WARNINGS).
- [ ] No `as any` casts (repo rule: no `any`, even in tests); prefer real types /
      `Partial` / typed mocks.
- [ ] The `Category` type duplication (service vs types) is resolved at the source, not
      patched per call site.
- [ ] Full unit suite still green.

## Blocked by

None - can start immediately. (Independent of issues 01–05, all done.)

26	- **Test the Resend webhook handler.** Extract `handleResendWebhook(req, deps)` from `Deno.serve` and inject its collaborators so the branch matrix (auth gates, body/attachment flow, notify-on-failure) is unit-testable in vitest. # Backlog

The single working list — features, UX bugs, engineering, open questions, and
refactoring. Refactoring items are summarized here as one-liners; the full
detail (smell, effort, sibling sites, plan) lives in
[Refactoring backlog](refactoring-backlog.md), which is a reference, not a
separate to-do list.

## Features

- **Receipt image — rotate.** Rotate left and right anywhere a receipt is viewed.
- **Profile — manage emails.** Let users add/edit the email addresses associated with their account.
- **Family editor.** Let a user create a family and then invite other users to join it.
- **iPhone camera.** Use the Camera app on iPhone to take photos of receipts.
- **Recent-categories dropdown & a11y _(optional UX, low priority)_.** Recent-categories dropdown section (exp2b), mobile-responsive category dropdown (exp8a), and category-dropdown ARIA/screen-reader support (exp8b) were specced but never built.
- **Specced-but-unbuilt UX bits _(optional, low priority)_.** Email-flow vendor auto-assignment (vca2a email path) and the read-only "Rate: 1 EUR = …" text in the receipt edit modal (fcr2b) were specced but not implemented.

## Bugs / UX issues

- **Category edit scrolls to top.** When a category is edited we always scroll back up to the top of the window.
- **Category dropdown clipped.** The category dropdown in the editor window is out of view when clicked.
- **Blank transaction date hint.** When the transaction date is blank, show the expected date format for someone who is typing.

## Engineering

- **Test the Resend webhook handler.** Extract `handleResendWebhook(req, deps)` from `Deno.serve` and inject its collaborators so the branch matrix (auth gates, body/attachment flow, notify-on-failure) is unit-testable in vitest. See [PRD — Make the Resend webhook handler testable](prd-resend-handler-testability.md).
- **Unmatched-expenses filter never finished.** `Expense.matched_transaction_id` is selected, populated, and unit-tested, but no Expenses-page UI consumes it — the "Hide Matched" toggle (umf1a/2a/3a) was specced but never built. Decide: build the toggle or drop the field.

### Test-coverage backlog

Optional, low-priority follow-ups — pure test coverage, no behaviour change.

- **Expenses CSV export filename.** Extract + unit-test the Expenses-page CSV export filename branching (`expenses_<from>_to_<to>.csv` etc.), currently inline and untested in `src/routes/expenses/+page.svelte`.
- **`getSignedReceiptUrl()` edge cases.** Add direct unit tests for null/empty-path → null (no API call) and storage-error → null (no throw), and assert the 300s OCR signed-URL expiry; today only the batch `collectSignedUrls` variant is tested.
- **PDF export dimensions & row numbering.** Add `PDFExportService` assertions for US-Letter page dimensions (612×792) and the per-category row-number restart at 1, currently unasserted.
- **Resend handler orchestration.** The process-all-attachments loop and body-text fallback (eaf4a/eaf5a) stay unit-untestable until the handler is refactored to be importable — tracked in [PRD — Make the Resend webhook handler testable](prd-resend-handler-testability.md).

## Refactoring

Open items only — full detail in [Refactoring backlog](refactoring-backlog.md).
(RF-01–03 are done; RF-D1/D2 are deferred pending a decision.)

- **[RF-04](refactoring-backlog.md#rf-04--findpotentialmatches-vs-findpotentialmatchesfortransaction-are-a-copy-paste-pair)** — De-duplicate the `findPotentialMatches` / `findPotentialMatchesForTransaction` copy-paste pair.
- **[RF-05](refactoring-backlog.md#rf-05--long-methods-in-the-service-layer)** — Break up the long methods in the service layer.
- **[RF-06](refactoring-backlog.md#rf-06--matching-tolerances-are-a-long-parameter-list--data-clump)** — Bundle the matching tolerances (Long Parameter List / Data Clump) into one object _(correctness-adjacent)_.
- **[RF-07](refactoring-backlog.md#rf-07--singleton-vs-dependency-injection-split-across-services)** — Reconcile the singleton-vs-dependency-injection split across services.
- **[RF-08](refactoring-backlog.md#rf-08--any-where-a-precise-type-exists)** — Replace `any` with precise types where one already exists.
- **[RF-09](refactoring-backlog.md#rf-09--three-inconsistent-ways-to-resolve-a-rows-category)** — Collapse the three inconsistent ways to resolve a row's Category into one.
- **[RF-10](refactoring-backlog.md#rf-10--reconciliationservice-does-ui-display-massaging)** — Move UI display massaging out of `ReconciliationService` (Feature Envy).
- **[RF-11](refactoring-backlog.md#rf-11--normalizeamountinvertsign-boolean-flag-argument)** — Replace the `normalizeAmount(invertSign: boolean)` flag argument.
- **[RF-12](refactoring-backlog.md#rf-12--magic-number-matching-defaults)** — Name the magic-number matching defaults.
- **[RF-13](refactoring-backlog.md#rf-13--pdfexportserviceshouldenablepdfexport-static--state-object)** — Fix `PDFExportService.shouldEnablePDFExport` (Inappropriate Static + state object).

## Open questions

- **Combining receipts for one expense.** How to handle when two receipts should be combined into one expense to match — e.g. two medications picked up at the same time.
- **WealthSimple refund handling.** WealthSimple records several rows when a refund is issued. Example:

  ```csv
  "2026-05-24","2026-05-24","Refund initiated","MARSHES GOLF CORPORATI","-33.9","CAD"
  "2026-05-24","2026-05-25","Refund settled","MARSHES GOLF CORPORATI","33.9","CAD"
  "2026-05-24","2026-05-25","Refund settled","MARSHES GOLF CORPORATI","-33.9","CAD"
  ```
